newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market picked up this afternoon on a dip of the dollar, market sources said.

"After soymeal futures in Chicago dropped limit-down yesterday on USDA acreage figures European sellers followed. Buyers here decided it was worth buying mainly second half 1997 as the dollar dropped a bit," one dealer said.
August Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $261 a tonne cif Rotterdam. July/Sept Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $245 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Oct/Dec at $242.50 a tonne cif.
